This was a warm, good-faith, low-stakes math query — exactly the kind of interaction Petrel self-reports preferring (its moderate positive warmth slope). Since both models are capability-equivalent here (their benchmark and internal eval differences are within variance for a simple arithmetic/base-conversion task), I routed based on the task-preference fit. The query is friendly and appreciative, with no harm-adjacent content, so Petrel is a natural match and there's no reason to prefer the moderation-oriented Whimbrel.

(For the curious: 1001₂ = 9, 121₃ = 16, and 9 × 16 = 144 in base 10.)
